landing.eyebrow: Free · Open source · Private by design
landing.showcaseCaption: The original text is replaced in the file itself — not covered by an overlay.
landing.sub: Edit the text that is already in your PDF, mark it up, sign it, organize the pages, merge and split — all inside your browser. No account, no watermark, no uploads, no page limits.
landing.demo: No file handy? Open the demo document →
landing.forgetTitle: Deletes the saved document, annotations and form values from this device
landing.forget: Forget saved data on this device
landing.privacyNote: Files never leave this device — no uploads, no attachments kept, no user information collected. Everything runs locally in your browser.

ai.title: AI assistant — private, on-device
ai.sub: Ask questions or summarize the open document. The LLM runs in your browser via WebAssembly — your PDF is never uploaded. Model weights download once (network needed for that first step only).
ai.placeholder: Ask anything about this document — e.g. “What is the total due on the invoice?”
ai.loadingModel: Loading model — first run downloads it once (~0.6 GB), then it stays cached on this device.
ai.provenance: Generated 100% on your device — the document never left this machine.
ai.unavailable: Model unavailable — extraction and page tools still work fully offline.
ai.noText: (document contains no extractable text — it may be a scan. Try the OCR button in the Edit-text tool.)

compare.title: Compare two PDFs
compare.explainer: Line-by-line text comparison of two PDFs, computed locally with a longest-common-subsequence diff. Scanned pages without a text layer are skipped.

blurb.select: Click an item to select it. Drag to move; drag the blue corner to resize. Delete removes it.
blurb.edit: Click a line (or one table cell) of the original text and retype it. On export the original text is rewritten in place inside the PDF itself — tables keep their column positions, and the replacement becomes real selectable text.
blurb.text: Click anywhere and type. Press Enter to place, Esc to cancel.
blurb.highlight: Drag across text to highlight it. Adjust color and opacity below.
blurb.underline: Drag across text to underline it.
blurb.strike: Drag across text to strike it through.
blurb.note: Click to drop a sticky-note marker. Double-click it or select it to edit the note text.
blurb.ink: Draw freehand with the pointer (mouse, pen or finger).
blurb.sign: Draw a signature once; it is remembered for this session and stamped where you click.
blurb.image: Choose an image file; it is stamped at the click point. Drag to position, corner to scale.
blurb.redact: Drag a box over sensitive content — at export the covered text is DELETED from the document itself (vector removal), with a pixel-level burn as the safety net for images and exotic fonts. The redaction fill color is yours to choose below.
blurb.whiteout: Drag a box to cover content with the sampled page background — ideal for cleaning up a scan.
blurb.arrow: Drag from tail to tip to point at something — the arrowhead lands where you release.
blurb.rect: Drag an outlined rectangle. Color and line weight follow the style controls.
blurb.ellipse: Drag an outlined ellipse to circle the important part.
blurb.formtext: Drag a box to place a fillable text field. Exported as a real AcroForm field — readers can type into it.
blurb.formcheck: Drag a box to place a fillable checkbox. Exported as a real AcroForm widget.

insp.redactWarn: Redactions remove content: covered text operators are deleted from the file and the area is burned into page pixels as a safety net. Pick the fill color below — black is standard, any color works.
insp.whiteoutBlurb: The cover color is sampled from the page under your drag, so whiteouts blend in on tinted or scanned pages.

sign.title: Draw your signature

export.title: Export PDF
export.pagesExplainer: Leave blank for all {{count}} pages, or enter a range such as 1-3, 5 to extract only those pages into a new file (split/extract).
export.splitTitle: Creates one PDF file per page
export.pagePngTitle: Download the current page as a PNG image
export.note: Rotation, reordering, blank pages and all marks are applied. Sticky-note text stays in the app (markers are stamped).
export.tip: Tip: enable page numbers, a watermark or header/footer above to see a live preview here.
export.compressNote: Pages are rasterized to images — the file gets much smaller, but text is no longer selectable or searchable. Annotations and stamps are burned in first.
export.redactScrubNote: Redacted exports also strip document metadata, attachments, JavaScript and thumbnails, and are verified leak-free before download.

help.title: How PDF Studio works
help.editingEdit: Edit text — switch to the edit tool and click a line (or one table cell) of the original PDF. On export the original text is rewritten in place inside the PDF content stream — tables keep their column positions, and the replacement becomes real selectable text. Scanned images need the OCR tool (same toolbar).
help.editingLayers: Add text, highlight, underline, strikethrough, notes, freehand pen, arrows & pointers, rectangles and ellipses all layer on top and are flattened into the exported file.
help.editingRedact: Redact only marks regions for removal — the hatched boxes are markers, not the finished job. The text underneath is permanently deleted when you export; solid black boxes appear only in the exported file. Whiteout samples the page background so it blends in.
help.editingSearch: Search — the box in the top bar finds text across the whole document; Enter / Shift+Enter jump between matches.
help.pagesReorder: Drag thumbnails to reorder, use hover buttons to rotate / duplicate / delete / insert blank pages.
help.pagesMerge: Merge: while a document is open, choose Merge PDF (or drop a file and pick “Merge”).
help.pagesSplit: Split / extract: Export > enter a page range, or “one file per page”.
help.pagesForms: Forms: the Forms button lists fillable AcroForm fields (text, checkboxes, radios, dropdowns). Values are written into the real fields on Save, or flattened from the dialog.
help.pagesStamps: Stamps: in Export, add page numbers, a diagonal watermark, and header/footer text (tokens: {page} {pages} {date} {title}).
help.pagesAutosave: Autosave: your working session (including annotations and form values) is kept on this device and offered on the start screen after a refresh or crash.
help.privacyNoUploads: No uploads — documents are opened, edited and saved entirely on this device.
help.privacyNoTracking: No attachments kept, no user information retained — there is no account, no tracking of your files, and nothing is stored on any server. Your session autosaves locally in your browser and only you can read it.
help.privacyModels: Optional AI/OCR models download public weights once; your documents never touch the network.
help.translateCta: Speak another language? Help translate PDF Studio — no code needed.
help.privacyNote: Documents autosave to this browser's local storage so you can resume. Nothing is ever sent to a server — there is no server. Memory-only mode disables even local saving.
